def solve(case):
    nodes = case.get("nodes")
    required_symbols = case.get("required_symbols", [])
    if not nodes:
        raise ValueError("Missing nodes")
    # Build maps
    id_to_node = {}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        nid = n["id"]
        id_to_node[nid] = n
        children.setdefault(nid, [])
    for n in nodes:
        parent = n.get("parent")
        if parent is not None:
            children[parent].append(n["id"])
    # Count required symbols
    symbol_count = {}
    for n in nodes:
        sym = n["symbol"]
        if sym in required_symbols:
            symbol_count[sym] = symbol_count.get(sym, 0) + 1
    # Sort nodes: depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    removed = set()
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    removal_order = []
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n["id"]
        if nid in removed:
            continue
        if not n.get("removable", False):
            continue
        if n.get("parent") is None:  # root
            continue
        # Check if any child retained
        has_retained_child = any(cid not in removed for cid in children.get(nid, []))
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # Check required symbol removal
        sym = n["symbol"]
        if sym in required_symbols and symbol_count.get(sym, 0) <= 1:
            continue  # removing would eliminate last occurrence
        # Remove
        removed.add(nid)
        retained.discard(nid)
        if sym in required_symbols:
            symbol_count[sym] -= 1
        removal_order.append(nid)
    # Sort retained IDs
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removal_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
